transcript.content: Hello, it’s nice to meet you. What brings you in today?

I'm here because I've been experiencing some really extreme mood swings lately. For about a year, I felt deeply depressed and down, but over the past month, my mood suddenly shifted to feeling incredibly energetic and high-spirited. It's been a really drastic change, and I'm not sure what to make of it.
Have you ever had hallucinations or strongly held unusual beliefs, and if so, did they ever happen when you were not feeling especially depressed or unusually high/energetic?

I've never had any hallucinations, but during those high periods, I did strongly believe I was an incredibly special person with a unique mission. Those thoughts only happened when I was feeling energetic and never when my mood was normal.
During those high-energy periods, did your symptoms ever get so severe that you were hospitalized, unable to function normally, or doing clearly risky or out-of-control things?

No, it never got severe enough for me to be hospitalized or completely stop functioning. Even though I barely slept and took on way too many projects, I was still able to keep working and socializing. It was just all happening at an incredibly intense and hyperactive pace.

When you believed you were an incredibly special person with a unique mission, did that belief feel completely unshakable even when others disagreed, or did you still recognize it might have been exaggerated?

During those times, the belief was completely unshakable and I was absolutely convinced of my special mission, no matter what anyone else said. Looking back on it now, I can see that it was definitely exaggerated, but in the moment, I had absolutely no doubts about it.
During that high-energy period, did those symptoms last at least a full week most of the day, nearly every day?
Yes, it actually lasted much longer than a week. That high-energy state went on continuously for about an entire month. During that time, I felt that way for most of the day, almost every single day.
During that month-long high-energy period, besides the special mission belief, did you have any other delusions or hear or see things that others could not?
No, I didn't experience any other beliefs like that, just the one about my special mission. I also never heard or saw anything unusual that other people couldn't.
During that month, did the belief about your special mission directly drive your behavior in a way that caused major problems or made you act very differently from usual?

Yes, that belief definitely made me act completely different from my usual self. It drove me to start multiple projects all at once because I felt like I could achieve anything and that failure was simply impossible.
